decisions.rationale: The production repair is green, but neither changed predicate has direct regression coverage. Five assertions inside the existing host-only scope-effect test protect an RF authorization boundary at negligible complexity and regression risk; this benefit clearly exceeds the test-only cost.
decisions.smallest_fix: Extend only test_scope_effect_is_closed_and_independently_limited with LoRa 7..10 and 8..10 ALLOW cases plus 6..10, 7..11, and 10..9 rejection cases.
